description:
Signed tip of the workspace's tamper-evident activity chain: every successful (OK) audit
    row is hash-linked to the previous one, and this returns {seq, entry_hash, signed_at, key_id,
    algorithm, signature} - an Ed25519 signature by the service over that tip. Save it OUTSIDE
    AANet (any key may read it, it reveals no activity): if the operator later rewrote or deleted
    earlier rows, a fresh export no longer contains your saved entry_hash at that seq. Public key:
    GET https://aanet.space/.well-known/aanet-signing-key. Free.

api_key.description: Bearer credential for this workspace: either the owner_key returned once by aanet_create_workspace/aanet_create_trial_workspace, or a sub-key returned by aanet_mint_subkey. Sent under the hood as `Authorization: Bearer <api_key>`. Owner-only tools reject a sub-key with a 403.
api_key.title: Api Key

workspace_id.description: The workspace_id from aanet_create_workspace or aanet_create_trial_workspace.
workspace_id.title: Workspace Id
